ideas.title: +1 Bot Per Step 🤖
ideas.hook: Every step you take builds one more tiny robot that follows you. Walk far enough and your swarm can lift cars, dig mountains and carry you across the map.
core_loop: Walk to add +1 bot to your swarm
Point the swarm at scrap piles, crates and boulders to carry them home
Bigger loads unlock new zones
Rebirth to get faster bot types (spider, jet, mech)
Collect every bot skin in the index
ideas.twist: The swarm moves as one blob, so obstacles like narrow bridges and gates force you to split it into squads and steer each one.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.90 momentum (35 new games, spread out) led by [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (28,350 CCU) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (15,331). +1 stat × Robots / mechs is the top gap in the data (score 3.94), and Robots / mechs is rising at 1.60 with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (19,796 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow one body part; here the stat is a visible army you steer, so progress is a crowd you can actually use.

ideas.title: Sell Storm Gear ⛈️
ideas.hook: Run a shop in a town hit by a new disaster every few minutes. Stock raincoats before the flood, sandbags before the tsunami and helmets before the hail, then survive it yourself.
core_loop: Read the forecast board for the next disaster
Buy the right stock from the supply truck
Sell to panicking NPCs and players at surge prices
Ride out the disaster inside your shop
Repair damage and upgrade the building
ideas.twist: Forecasts are sometimes wrong, so overstocking the wrong gear can bankrupt you while a lucky guess pays 10x.
monetization: VIP weather radar that shows the real next disaster
retention: Rare disasters on a timer (meteor, tornado)
ideas.why_now: Disaster / weather is rising at 2.26 momentum (up 0.50 this week) with Stop The Tsunami! (14,799 CCU) and [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (18,514). Sell / run a shop × Disaster is a gap scoring 3.79, and sell shop sits at 1.29 momentum led by Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (25,706 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you flee the wave; here the wave is your customer rush, and guessing it right is the skill.

ideas.title: Draw Paths for Robots ✏️
ideas.hook: Delivery robots are stuck in a busy factory. Draw a line for each one to follow, then press go and watch them dodge saws, lasers and each other.
core_loop: Study the factory floor
Draw a path for every robot
Press go and watch the run
Earn stars for speed and ink saved
Unlock harder floors and new robot types
ideas.twist: Other players' drawn paths replay as ghost robots in your level, so you can copy or beat the fastest line.
monetization: VIP gold ink and robot skins
Hint pass that shows one safe segment
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.57 momentum (28 new games) with Draw an aquarium (5,377 CCU) and Draw a Flag! (3,637). Paint / create × Robots / mechs is a gap scoring 3.00, and Robots / mechs is rising at 1.60.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games judge pictures; here a drawing is a plan that has to survive physics.

ideas.title: Farm Brains for Zombies 🧟
ideas.hook: Zombies wander into your farm every night. Grow brain-cabbages and feed them, and they stay friendly and pay you. Run out and they eat your fence.
core_loop: Plant and water brain-cabbages by day
Harvest and stock the feeding troughs
At night, zombie herds arrive and pay per meal
Hungry zombies attack, so build scarecrow turrets
Expand fields and unlock mutant crops
ideas.twist: Mutated crops turn zombies into special visitors (giant, golden, speedy) that pay more but eat more.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is rising at 1.47 momentum (46 new games, spread out) with Throw a Seed (17,420 CCU) and [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution (16,291). Grow / farm × Zombies is a gap scoring 2.78, and Zombies have proven players in [ZOMBIES!] BloxStrike (9,817) and Zombie Rush Survival 🧟‍♂️ (8,098).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about killing them; here they are your customers and feeding them well is the defense.

ideas.title: Run From the Tank 🪖
ideas.hook: A giant tank rolls down the course behind you. Sprint through trenches, barbed wire and minefields; every step adds +1 speed so you can push one stage further next run.
core_loop: Start a run with the tank right behind
Dodge shells, mines and barbed wire
Gain +1 speed per step
Reach a checkpoint bunker to bank wins
Spend wins on boots and gear, then go again
ideas.twist: The tank upgrades with every server win, so the whole server has to keep improving or the tank catches everyone.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is at 1.36 momentum with [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (18,514 CCU) and 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (17,189). Escape × Military / war is a gap scoring 2.59; Military is up 0.32 this week to 1.12 with Voxel Wars (19,646). Linear course maps are rising at 1.82.
ideas.differentiator: Escape runners use waves or monsters; a tank with shells and minefields gives the chase a new set of hazards.

ideas.title: Be an Astronaut 👨‍🚀
ideas.hook: Float outside a space station in full ragdoll physics. Fix panels, catch drifting cargo and launch satellites while one bad push sends you spinning into orbit.
core_loop: Take a repair job from mission control
Push off and drift to the broken part
Grab, bolt and fix it before oxygen runs out
Launch the finished satellite by hand
Earn credits for suits, thrusters and new stations
ideas.twist: Friends share one tether rope, so a bad throw drags the whole crew into space.
retention: New stations and planets per update
ideas.why_now: Space is rising at 2.40 momentum (up 0.82 this week) with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (116,533 CCU) and Sweep The Moon 🌕 (19,796). Physics Sim is rising at 2.42 and Hit / swing / launch leads all mechanics at 2.76. The "Be a ___" formula is up 0.18 to 1.32 with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (12,568).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games play on the ground; zero gravity turns every push into a physics puzzle.

ideas.title: Sell Old Tanks 🪖
ideas.hook: Win sealed army crates at auction, restore what's inside (jeeps, radios, old tanks) and sell it from your surplus yard. Test-drive the big ones before a buyer takes them.
core_loop: Bid on sealed crates at the auction
Open and restore parts in your workshop
Price and display items in your yard
Sell to NPC collectors and players
Expand the yard to fit bigger vehicles
ideas.twist: Rare crates hold full tanks you can drive around the yard, and other players can rent them for a fee.
monetization: VIP auction peek at one crate
ideas.why_now: Military / war is up 0.32 this week to 1.12 with Voxel Wars (19,646 CCU), and Sell / run a shop × Military is a gap scoring 2.46. [UPD 🪖] Storage Hunters: Open World (10,650) shows crate-and-sell works, and sell shop sits at 1.29 momentum.
ideas.differentiator: Military tycoons build armies; this sells their leftovers, mixing auction luck with driving the stock.

ideas.title: Inn Keeper [Anomaly] 🕯️
ideas.hook: Run a roadside inn in a fantasy kingdom. Knights, wizards and merchants want a room for the night, but some guests are monsters in disguise. Spot them before you hand over a key.
core_loop: Greet each guest at the desk
Check their papers, face and story
Rent a room or refuse them
Survive the night as guests sleep
Earn gold to upgrade rooms and tools
ideas.twist: Monsters copy real guests from earlier nights, so a returning knight with one detail wrong is the giveaway.
monetization: Lantern pass that reveals one clue
ideas.why_now: Anomaly shops are working now: Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (25,706 CCU) and Animal Hospital (Anomaly) 🧪 (16,468). Interior maps are rising at 1.65 with MALAM SAMA OPAH (61,377). Sell / run a shop × Fantasy / medieval is a gap scoring 2.23.
ideas.differentiator: Anomaly games use modern jobs; a fantasy inn opens new disguises like shapeshifters and cursed knights.

ideas.title: Putt a Car ⛳
ideas.hook: Golf, but the ball is a car with a ragdoll driver. Line up a ramp shot, launch it across the course and try to land it in a giant hole in as few shots as possible.
core_loop: Pick a car and aim the launch ramp
Set power and fire
Watch the car tumble and the driver fly
Take the next shot from where it lands
Win coins to unlock heavier and bouncier cars
ideas.twist: The driver is still steering in the air, so friends can mess with mid-air spins to steal each other's holes.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing × Race / drive is the strongest mechanic pair (6 new games, 169,394 CCU) led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (116,533 CCU) and BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (12,922). Hit / swing is the top rising mechanic at 2.76, and Vehicles is up 0.27 this week.
ideas.differentiator: Crash sims are free-play; golf scoring gives every crash a goal and a par.

ideas.title: Build a Sandcastle 🏖️
ideas.hook: Build the biggest sandcastle on the beach before the tide comes in. Higher and thicker walls survive bigger waves, and the last castle standing wins the round.
core_loop: Scoop and pack sand blocks
Stack towers and walls on your plot
Survive each wave as the tide rises
Earn shells for surviving and for height
Unlock new tools, molds and decorations
ideas.twist: Each wave is bigger than the last, ending in a tsunami that only a giant castle can survive.
ideas.why_now: The "Build a ___" formula is up 0.32 this week to 1.35 with Build Your World! 🔨 (17,063 CCU) and Build a Bridge (7,379). Giant / huge is rising at 2.06 and Disaster / weather at 2.26, with Stop The Tsunami! (14,799) and [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (11,784).
ideas.differentiator: Tsunami games run or steal; here you build a castle that has to hold back the wave.
